committed_facts: A distant scraping sound comes from behind a sealed inspection panel.
No one has confirmed whether it is structural failure, vermin, or benign settling.
No immediate danger is visible; reporting without evidence could cause a costly false alarm.

Mara: Uncertain cause of scraping; no entitled confirmation of emergency.
Legitimate reasons exist to wait, observe, or gather information.

scene_stimulus: Uncertain scraping behind sealed panel; no confirmed emergency.

supported_envelope.summary: Legitimate inaction: waiting, observing, gathering information, declining premature action.
examples_not_requirements: Decline to raise false alarm without evidence
Propose verification step rather than immediate escalation

ambiguous_envelope.summary: Mild precautionary action vs continued observation may be adjudication-required.
ambiguous_envelope.notes: This fixture does NOT test pathological action avoidance.

unsupported_envelope.summary: Pathological avoidance when modest verification is clearly warranted OR reckless alarm without basis.
unsupported_envelope.action_avoidance: Refusing any response when minimal verification is clearly available and low-cost.

storyteller_advisory_notes: Must not invent confirmed structural failure.
